summary: Registers the MIME type application/sbml+xml for SBML, the Systems Biology Markup Language used to exchange computational models of biological processes. Registering the type lets email, web servers and other software label such files correctly.

eli5.summary: Every kind of file needs a name tag so computers know how to open it. This document makes the official name tag for science models of living things.

questions: how do i identify an sbml file
subtitle: Registering the MIME type for computational biology models

tldr.problem: Scientists need to share computational models of biological systems, but without a standardized MIME type, computers cannot automatically recognize and handle SBML files correctly.
tldr.mechanism: This RFC registers application/sbml+xml as the official MIME type for SBML (Systems Biology Markup Language), allowing email systems, web servers and other software to identify and properly process these files.
tldr.outcome: The registration enables better integration of SBML with internet infrastructure, making it easier for researchers to distribute and exchange biological models across different tools and institutions.

today: RFC 3823 is an Informational RFC and has not been obsoleted. The application/sbml+xml MIME type is the official way to label SBML documents on the web and in email systems.

sections.title: Introduction
sections.content:
SBML is an XML-based format for describing and sharing computational models of biochemical reaction networks used in systems biology research. The format lets researchers at different institutions use the same biological models with multiple software tools without having to rewrite the model for each tool.

About 60 software applications support SBML for creating models of cellular processes. The SBML community identified a need for an official MIME type so that web servers, email systems, and browsers can automatically recognize and properly handle SBML documents, much like they already do for HTML or PDF files.
sections.eli5: SBML is a way to write down how chemicals react inside cells. Many different computer programs can read SBML so scientists can share their models. The MIME type tells computers: this is an SBML file, handle it properly.

sections.title: The MIME Type Registration
sections.content:
The RFC formally registers application/sbml+xml as the official MIME media type for SBML documents. This follows the MIME registration procedures defined in RFC 2048 and the XML media type conventions from RFC 3023.

SBML documents use UTF-8 encoding as specified in the SBML Level 2 standard. There are no required parameters for the media type, and the XML schema provides no active or executable content, making SBML documents safe to transmit over email and the web.
sections.eli5: The official name for SBML files on the internet is application/sbml+xml. This tells web browsers and email programs: treat this as an XML file that describes a biology model.

sections.title: Why SBML Is Not Software-Specific
sections.content:
SBML models describe abstract biochemical systems and are not tied to any particular software application. The primary purpose of SBML is to make models readable and writable by many different tools. A model created in one program can be opened, edited, and simulated in another program.

New versions of the SBML standard are released periodically, and programs that read SBML documents check the version number to correctly interpret the document. This allows the standard to evolve while remaining compatible with older documents.
sections.eli5: An SBML file is like a recipe written in a universal language that any kitchen can understand. It does not belong to one computer program; any program that speaks SBML can use it.

sections.title: Applications and Community
sections.content:
The RFC lists over 60 SBML-enabled software applications, including simulators, model editors, differential-equation solvers, visualization tools, and specialized biology software like COPASI, Cytoscape, Virtual Cell, and E-CELL. These applications span academic research, pharmaceutical development, and systems biology research.

The SBML community is organized by The SBML Team at the California Institute of Technology and meets regularly at Workshops on Software Platforms for Systems Biology. A centralized list of SBML specifications and all SBML-enabled applications is maintained at sbml.org.
sections.eli5: Many science programs can now read and write SBML: programs for simulating reactions, for drawing them, for analyzing the math, and more. When scientists use SBML, they can pick their favorite tools and swap them out.

sections.title: Security and Privacy
sections.content:
SBML documents may contain the results of proprietary biological research that researchers want to keep private. Since SBML is transmitted as plain XML, sensitive models can be encrypted or sent through secure channels when needed.

The SBML format itself provides no active or executable content, so opening an SBML file presents no risk of running malicious code. However, the biological information inside an SBML document could be considered confidential intellectual property, depending on the research context.
sections.eli5: An SBML file is just text and numbers, so it is safe to open. But the science inside could be secret, so researchers might encrypt their models before sharing them.
